from collections import Counter
def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    counts=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    color=min((v for v in counts if v!=0), key=lambda v:counts[v])
    cells=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==color]
    r0=min(r for r,c in cells); c0=min(c for r,c in cells)
    shape={(r-r0,c-c0) for r,c in cells}
    sh=max(r for r,c in shape)+1; sw=max(c for r,c in shape)+1
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h-sh+1):
        for c in range(w-sw+1):
            if all(grid[r+dr][c+dc]==0 for dr,dc in shape):
                for dr,dc in shape: out[r+dr][c+dc]=color
    return out

source='''from collections import Counter


def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(value for row in grid for value in row)
    color = min((value for value in counts if value != 0), key=lambda value: counts[value])

    cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == color]
    r0 = min(r for r, _ in cells)
    c0 = min(c for _, c in cells)
    shape = {(r - r0, c - c0) for r, c in cells}
    shape_h = max(r for r, _ in shape) + 1
    shape_w = max(c for _, c in shape) + 1

    output = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h - shape_h + 1):
        for c in range(w - shape_w + 1):
            if all(grid[r + dr][c + dc] == 0 for dr, dc in shape):
                for dr, dc in shape:
                    output[r + dr][c + dc] = color
    return output
'''
